svg.title: stable-qk-norm
svg.desc: Three ways to bound attention logits. QK-norm: RMS-normalised q and k with gain g give |logit| at most sqrt(d_h) g_q g_k, 11.3 for d_h = 128 and g = 1; toy histograms of 4,096 logits: without norm and with q, k grown 4x the logits spread to about plus or minus 50 and the top weight over 64 keys is near 1, with QK-norm they stay within the bound. Soft-cap (Gemma 2): c tanh(e / c) with c = 50 maps 50 to 38 and 100 to 48; final logits use c = 30. QK-Clip (Kimi K2, tau = 100): a head with max logit 250 gets gamma = 0.4 and W_q, W_k scaled by 0.63.
